records.statement: KTM's 2020 85 SX owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); white smoke or steam in the exhaust from a damaged cylinder head or head gasket; water in the oil from a damaged radial shaft seal ring or water pump; oil coming out of the vent hose from overfilling; wrong ignition timing from a loose stator; stalling or popping from lack of fuel, an intake air leak, or a loose/oxidized ignition connector; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter.

records.topic: 2027 250 SX-F ignition, fuel system and maps (owner's manual)

records.topic: 2027 FC 250 ignition, fuel system and maps (owner's manual)
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 250 owner's manual: Ignition: Contactless controlled fully electronic ignition with digital ignition adjustment; the left-bar combination switch selects STANDARD (balanced response, button 1) or ADVANCED (direct response, button 2) mapping below 4,000 rpm; traction control (TC button) can be added to either map and stays as last set at restart; launch control is armed at idle in neutral by holding TC and QS together; it caps full-throttle rpm off the start and switches off a few seconds after the start or if the throttle is closed past one third; the quickshifter (QS button) gives clutchless upshifts except 1st to 2nd; downshifts still need the clutch; fuel is metered by electronic fuel injection through a throttle body; a cold-start button on the throttle body lengthens injection time for cold starts; the malfunction indicator light gives blink codes 02, 06, 09, 12, 13, 21, 33, 37, 41 (e.g. 02 crankshaft sensor, 06 throttle position sensor) that are read with the diagnostics tool.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2027 (2027 FC 250), item no. 3402945en

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 250 owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); high oil consumption (bent engine vent hose, oil level too high, oil too thin, worn piston or cylinder, leaking engine case); malfunction indicator lamp on or flashing (fuel-injection fault: check wiring and connectors for corrosion, read the fault memory with the diagnostics tool); no start or low power from a clogged fuel screen in the quick-lock fuel coupling; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter or fuel filter/screen.

records.topic: 2027 FC 450 ignition, fuel system and maps (owner's manual)
records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 450 owner's manual: Ignition: Contactless controlled fully electronic ignition with digital ignition adjustment; the left-bar combination switch selects STANDARD (balanced response, button 1) or ADVANCED (direct response, button 2) mapping below 4,000 rpm; traction control (TC button) can be added to either map and stays as last set at restart; launch control is armed at idle in neutral by holding TC and QS together; it caps full-throttle rpm off the start and switches off a few seconds after the start or if the throttle is closed past one third; the quickshifter (QS button) gives clutchless upshifts except 1st to 2nd; downshifts still need the clutch; fuel is metered by electronic fuel injection through a throttle body; a cold-start button on the throttle body lengthens injection time for cold starts; the malfunction indicator light gives blink codes 02, 06, 09, 12, 13, 21, 33, 37, 41 (e.g. 02 crankshaft sensor, 06 throttle position sensor) that are read with the diagnostics tool.

source.name: Husqvarna Motorcycles Owner's Manual 2027 (2027 FC 450 FX 450), item no. 3402948en

records.statement: Husqvarna's 2027 FC 450 owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); high oil consumption (bent engine vent hose, oil level too high, oil too thin, worn piston or cylinder, leaking engine case); malfunction indicator lamp on or flashing (fuel-injection fault: check wiring and connectors for corrosion, read the fault memory with the diagnostics tool); no start or low power from a clogged fuel screen in the quick-lock fuel coupling; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter or fuel filter/screen.

records.topic: 2027 MC 450F ignition, fuel system and maps (owner's manual)
records.statement: GasGas's 2027 MC 450F owner's manual: Ignition: Contactless controlled fully electronic ignition with digital ignition adjustment; throttle response is changed with a throttle-grip guide plate: gray (fitted from the factory) opens the throttle valve more slowly, black more quickly; fuel is metered by electronic fuel injection through a throttle body; a cold-start button on the throttle body lengthens injection time for cold starts; the malfunction indicator light gives blink codes 02, 06, 09, 12, 13, 21, 33, 37, 41 (e.g. 02 crankshaft sensor, 06 throttle position sensor) that are read with the diagnostics tool.

records.statement: GasGas's 2027 MC 450F owner's manual troubleshooting table covers: engine overheating (low coolant, too little airflow, dirty radiator fins, foaming coolant, damaged head or head gasket, bent radiator hose); high oil consumption (bent engine vent hose, oil level too high, oil too thin, worn piston or cylinder, leaking engine case); malfunction indicator lamp on or flashing (fuel-injection fault: check wiring and connectors for corrosion, read the fault memory with the diagnostics tool); no start or low power from a clogged fuel screen in the quick-lock fuel coupling; power loss from a leaking or deformed exhaust or packed-out silencer; low power from a very dirty air filter or fuel filter/screen.
